title: Easy to use and gives your up to date info when linked to surveys
body:
This app was built in a way that suits users when referring to it on mobile phones. 
One touch to reach the sheet, then you can easily track through the different cells, numbers, comments, equations and survey questions... 

I would recommend one thing to improve at the moment, which is to provide the graphical illustration of numbers (when providing survey responses) to track through numbers while illustrated in bar charts, or graphs and so on...
Moreover, I noticed that records here don't upstate in synch with the present records of responses (I mean that I have moved responses from the English version of a survey to the Arabic version and deleted them from the English (and vise versa) but this wasn't updated like when checking the record on my laptop)...
